research_question: Can an audited 10D-main and 5D-support score improve net forward strategy performance without historical winner selection or silent input fallback?

required_input_contract_after_remediatio.target_day_key_domain_rule: 5D and 10D key domains must exactly match the audited target universe; any missing full row fails closed
required_input_contract_after_remediatio.field_null_rule: Declared field-level natural nulls are handled only by a separately frozen rule; full-row absence must never be filled with 0.5
required_input_contract_after_remediatio.duplicate_key_rule: trade_date + stock_code duplicate count must equal zero

information_timing.signal_time: T close after formal scores are available
information_timing.signal_inputs: Only T-or-earlier audited score and L2 fields
information_timing.t_plus_one_open_gate: raw open, raw pre_close and raw limit state only; never part of T signal selection

universe_and_filter_order: exclude ST and risk warning using target-day governed L2 fields
exclude delisting and delisting-risk names using target-day fields
require amount >= 90000 and total_mv >= 200000 using target-day values
rank by blend score desc then stock_code asc
take TopN and refill after any execution-day rejection

parameter_grid.position_rule: equal weight across accepted names, no leverage

buy_and_sell_rules.buy: At each frozen rebalance frequency, buy highest-ranked accepted names up to TopN
buy_and_sell_rules.sell: After minimum hold, sell only when held rank is below the frozen threshold and an accepted challenger exceeds held blend score by at least 0.02; force sell at maximum hold
buy_and_sell_rules.t_plus_one_constraint: No same-day sell of a newly bought A-share position
buy_and_sell_rules.refill: After T+1 limit-up, suspension or other hard rejection, refill in frozen rank order until TopN or candidate exhaustion
buy_and_sell_rules.shortage_audit: Record requested TopN, accepted count, rejection reason and exhausted-candidate count for every buy day

cost_and_execution.fill_price: T+1 raw unadjusted open after execution hard gates

historical_seen_period.usage: descriptive lineage audit only; forbidden for parameter selection or admission

observation.end_rule: the 120th valid A-share trading day from start, inclusive

unseen_forward.start_rule: first A-share trading day after the frozen 120-day observation window

observation_selection_order: discard any case failing a strong gate
maximize minimum Sharpe across three consecutive 40-trading-day slices
prefer lower TopN and lower parameter complexity
metric_disclosure: Juejin pnl_ratio_annual labelled platform linear annualization and non-CAGR
unseen_forward_open_conditions: one observation candidate passes every frozen gate
candidate parameters and selection evidence are frozen before forward access
all code, config and input asset hashes are frozen
audit-agent explicitly approves opening the forward window
no rule or threshold changes after observation results are read
stop_conditions: model remediation or reaudit does not grant allow_for_preregistered_strategy_observation_only
input hash, table, schema or key-domain mismatch
any missing target-day full row or silent 0.5 fallback
any SQLite, legacy, research fallback or BJ row
any future-window access before the required freeze
no candidate passes all observation promotion gates
Juejin run cannot be reproduced exactly twice
a rule, grid or cost change is requested after observation begins
failure_policy: Report no passing candidate; do not relax gates, reopen the same observation window, or publish production assets
